requirements.title: Compiled input-contract SSOT
requirements.description: Mode-level logical inputs and source bindings compile deterministically across the reachable mode graph; caller inputs are normalized and rejected before any execution mutation, and later reads use the pinned execution contract.

validation.notes: The shipped graph compiles to a deterministic generic contract.
Invalid caller values are rejected before reservation or dispatch.
Live source mutation cannot reinterpret an existing execution.
Simulation projects the declared plan target and uses the same target scope as its round trace.

requirements.title: Immutable execution manifest
requirements.description: An execution pins its transitive mode-definition bundle and validated runtime input snapshot before it creates a round.

validation.notes: The parent and delegated definitions are pinned with stable digests.
Validated runtime inputs persist before any round exists.

requirements.title: Generic output and selected-message provenance
requirements.description: Schema-valid arbitrary outputs survive persistence and restart for guard routing, while the selected final assistant message retains replay-stable source-event provenance.

validation.notes: A novel output field routes identically after save and reload.
Final-message identity remains stable when candidate ordering changes.
